titre: La dépense de santé américaine accélère
sous_titre: Croissance des dépenses en 2024, en pourcentage, par grand poste

Ensemble des dépenses.texte: NHE grew 7.2% to $5.3 trillion in 2024, or $15,474 per person, and accounted for 18.0% of Gross Domestic Product

Soins hospitaliers.texte: Spending for hospital care services increased 8.9 percent in 2024 to reach $1.6 trillion.

Médecins et soins cliniques.texte: Spending for physician and clinical services increased 8.1 percent to $1.1 trillion in 2024

Soins à domicile.texte: home health care agencies increased 10.2 percent in 2024 to $169.4 billion

Équipements médicaux durables.texte: increased 5.4 percent in 2024 to $86.4 billion following growth of 5.8 percent in 2023
